improvements: The incident report now asks "Was this analysis right?" with a button that opens the verification page to tell us
The in-game HUD shows up again in screenshots and in OBS window or display capture
Steward now measures connection quality, latency and the other car's movement around each contact, to improve netcode detection in upcoming versions
The analysis now considers the yellow flags and caution shown before the contact, and slow or stopped cars ahead (the spotter's "accident ahead")
fixes: A slow car coming back into the racing line alongside you is no longer read as a rear-end by you
The HUD no longer stays on "Analyzing crash..." when an analysis cannot finish; it now shows whether the incident was queued or the analysis is unavailable
